title: Paneer Butter Masala
description: Paneer Butter Masala is a classic North Indian dish that combines soft paneer cubes with a rich, creamy, mildly spiced tomato-cashew gravy. Butter, cream, and aromatic spices give this curry its signature luxurious flavor.

ingredients.title: For the Gravy
items: Oil – 1 tbsp (optional, to prevent butter from burning)
Cashew nuts – ¼ cup, soaked in warm water for 15 minutes
Red chili powder – 1 tsp (adjust to taste)
Water – ½ cup, or as required for desired consistency

instruction.title: Step 1 – Preparing the Cashew Paste
steps: Drain the soaked cashews and blend them with 2–3 tbsp water until smooth.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Sautéing the Onions and Spices
steps: Heat butter and oil in a heavy-bottomed pan over medium heat.
Add cumin seeds and let them splutter.
Add finely chopped onions and sauté until golden brown.
Add ginger-garlic paste and cook for 1–2 minutes until aromatic.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Preparing the Tomato Base
steps: Add pureed tomatoes and cook for about 8–10 minutes until the oil separates.
Stir in red chili powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder, and salt.
Cook for another 2–3 minutes to allow the spices to blend into the tomato base.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Making the Gravy
steps: Add the prepared cashew paste and mix well.
Add water to adjust the consistency and bring the gravy to a gentle simmer.
Stir in sugar, if using, and garam masala.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Cooking the Paneer
steps: In a separate pan, lightly sauté the paneer cubes in 1 tbsp butter until golden, if desired.
Add the paneer cubes to the gravy and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in fresh cream and cook for another 2 minutes over low heat.

instruction.title: Step 6 – Garnishing and Serving
steps: Garnish with a swirl of fresh cream and chopped coriander leaves.
Serve hot with naan, roti, or steamed basmati rice.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve hot with naan or roti.
Pair with steamed basmati rice for a comforting meal.
For a festive presentation, garnish with a swirl of cream and fresh coriander.

chefTips: For a smoother gravy, strain the tomato-cashew mixture before cooking it further.
Use fresh, soft paneer for the best texture.
Adjust the amount of butter and cream to make the curry richer or lighter according to taste.
Avoid overcooking the paneer so that the cubes remain soft and tender.
